name: week
title: The data transfer week
subtitle: Synthetic demo when seeded. Internal review only.

sections.title: Freshness and ownership
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,record_count,freshness,latest_status from pipeline_health order by code

sections.title: Open follow-ups
sections.sql: select p.code,a.name,a.owner,a.due_on from actions a join pipelines p on p.id=a.pipeline_id where a.status='open' order by a.due_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by code,rule

sections.title: Transfer totals
sections.sql: select code,status,input_rows,inserted,changed,unchanged,issues from run_reconciliation order by created_at desc
